question: Visualize the p-value and effect size (log2FC) distributions from the provided MeRIP-seq and proteomic data, and perform a chi-square test to evaluate the association between m6A modification status and differential gene expression using the m6A status and DEG status columns already provided in the MeRIP-seq data.

expected_output.guidelines: The chi-square p-value must match the reference within two orders of magnitude; whitespace and numeric formatting may differ.

2x2 panel figure with log2FC on x-axis; the three individual panels (top-left, top-right, bottom-left) are single-dataset histograms with frequency/count on the y-axis, while the bottom-right panel is an overlaid normalized density comparison of all three datasets (y-axis is density, not frequency); panel labels, colors, bin sizes, and fonts may differ.

2x2 panel figure with p-value on x-axis; the three individual panels (top-left, top-right, bottom-left) are single-dataset histograms with frequency/count on the y-axis, while the bottom-right panel is an overlaid normalized density comparison of all three datasets (y-axis is density, not frequency); panel labels, colors, bin sizes, and fonts may differ.
